panels.title: SvcDown

panels.description: Hosts whose CPU is above the 1h average

targets.expr: count((100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance", mode="idle"}[5m])))) > avg_over_time((100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance", mode="idle"}[5m]))))[1h:])) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPUHigh

targets.expr: count((100 * windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}) < 10) or vector(0)
max(100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance", mode="idle"}[5m])))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Instances with page life expectancy under 300s
panels.title: LowPLE

panels.description: Hosts with processor queue above the 1h average
panels.title: ProcQ

panels.description: Lowest volume free % in the fleet

targets.expr: min(100 * windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: MinDisk

panels.description: MSSQL collector failed on a host that is still up

targets.expr: count(windows_mssql_collector_success{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 0 and on(instance) up{job="windows_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 1) or vector(0)
